name: Rescue OOX-09/HL!
summary: After the beacon has stirred the fallen homing robot, Oglethorpe Obnoticus speaks from the robot itself. OOX-09/HL needs an open, safe place to begin its take-off, so it is to be escorted to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, and then Oglethorpe waits in Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Walk to the Shore
sections.body: Oglethorpe's voice crackles from the robot again. The machine needs an open, safe place to begin a lengthy take-off procedure, and the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff will do nicely. Its built-in cloaking cannot be used yet, and Oglethorpe needs time to make it operational again.

sections.title: Word in Booty Bay
sections.body: Once the robot has been brought safely to the shore, Oglethorpe Obnoticus asks you to come and talk in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Where does the robot need to be escorted?
faq.answer: OOX-09/HL is to be taken to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, an open place where it can start its take-off.

faq.q: Who is responsible for creating this homing robot?
faq.answer: The robot is the work of the gnome Oglethorpe Obnoticus, who is in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why can't the robot simply take off where it was found?
faq.answer: Its take-off procedure is lengthy and needs an open, safe place. Meanwhile Oglethorpe needs time to make its cloaking operational again.

faq.q: Where do you go once the escort reaches the shore?
aliases: where to turn in rescue oox-09
faq.answer: Oglethorpe Obnoticus asks to be seen in Booty Bay once the robot is safely at the shore.
It follows Find OOX-09/HL!, in which the distress beacon was carried to the crashed robot.
